what.text: This page follows refugees from China in Macao SAR, China, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year from 1964 to 1972.
At the end of 1972, the last year in UNHCR's series for this group, it counted 75000 refugees.
Today refugees from China live mostly in India, the United States, France and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records interstate armed conflicts between China and India in 1962 and 1967, and between China and Myanmar and between China and Russia in 1969.
The fact pack does not say why these people left China.

when.text: The figure was at its highest, 80000, in 1964 and 1965.
It stayed close to that level throughout 1964 to 1972, the main years of displacement in the data.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or how they lived in Macao.
These are year-end totals for Macao SAR, China only, reported to UNHCR; the series ends in 1972.
